title: Answer: life and mind share one principle, but life is not enough

statements.text: Through FEP-AI, IWMT grounds mind and life in the same principle of self-evidencing persistence. Being alive does not make a system conscious: plants and fungi are likely unconscious forms of life.

sources.quote: provides a multi-level grounding for other theories in fundamental biophysics, thus linking mind and life
Without such capacities, plants (and fungi) are likely to be unconscious forms of life.
